name: TCC UniFAST - Google Workspace Continuity Scheduler

parameters.content:
## Setup required
Import inactive. Backend /api/internal/n8n/continuity-sync is not implemented yet.
Do not publish until signed endpoint, idempotent queue and Google connection are verified.
Google credentials stay in Laravel. Set matching CONTINUITY_SYNC_SECRET and allow crypto in Code nodes.
Default: hourly, Asia/Manila. Change Hourly Sync to adjust.
Manual Execute Workflow queues a request only; it does not prove sync completion.
